items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: I mean, I knew Pinky very well. As a matter of fact, they used to have dates with my present wife way back then. I was not playing the band at the same time Pinky was.

ctx.x: been going through my old notes that I've been going through my old notes that I've made with Johnny Harmon years ago and… I must have gotten a lot of information from Pinky one time, and Benji. Because there was such a change over in the band. Pinky came in after I left.
I mean, I knew Pinky very well. As a matter of fact, they used to have dates with my present wife way back then. I was not playing the band at the same time Pinky was.
Oh what did Fred Ogden play? I forgot to ask that.
